name: Feedback Calibration Integration
description: Wire feedback ratings into the existing attention/calibration.py module. Maps user feedback ratings (helpful, wrong, irrelevant, already_knew) to calibration actions that adjust agent confidence scores. Uses a CalibratorProtocol to decouple from the concrete calibration implementation. An ENABLED_DIMENSIONS gate controls which calibration dimensions are active; initially only 'agent_confidence' is enabled. Deferred dimensions (business_weight, familiarity_weight, surfacing_priority) are computed but skipped and logged until Features 3 and 4 land. Feedback is persisted in .stigmergy/feedback.jsonl as append-only JSONL. Module lives at attention/feedback_calibration.py (~200-300 lines) with tests at tests/test_feedback_calibration.py.

types.name: FeedbackRating
types.description: StrEnum of the four possible user feedback ratings for a finding.

types.name: CalibrationDimension
types.description: The calibration dimension a CalibrationAction targets. Only 'agent_confidence' is initially enabled; others are deferred.

types.name: FeedbackStatus
types.description: Outcome status of applying feedback. 'applied' = all actions applied, 'partial' = some skipped due to disabled dimensions, 'skipped' = all actions skipped.

types.name: FeedbackEntry

fields.name: feedback_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this feedback entry. UUID4 string generated by default_factory.

validators.error_message: feedback_id must be a valid UUID4 string

fields.name: finding_id
fields.description: The ID of the finding being rated.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: The ID of the agent that produced the finding being rated.

fields.name: rating
fields.description: The user's rating of the finding.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the feedback was given. Serialized as string; parsed as datetime internally. Must end with 'Z' or '+00:00'.

validators.error_message: timestamp must be ISO-8601 UTC format

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Optional free-form metadata dictionary for extensibility (e.g., user notes, session context).

types.description: Frozen Pydantic model representing a single user feedback event. Created when a user rates a finding via the CLI command 'stigmergy feedback <id> <rating>'.

types.name: CalibrationAction

fields.name: dimension
fields.description: The calibration dimension this action targets.

fields.name: delta
fields.description: Signed magnitude of the adjustment. Positive = increase, negative = decrease. Magnitude sourced from FeedbackCalibrationConfig constants.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Human-readable explanation of what this action does and why (e.g., 'Increase agent confidence: rating=helpful').

types.description: Frozen Pydantic model describing a single calibration adjustment to be applied (or skipped) for a given feedback event. Each rating maps to one or more CalibrationActions across different dimensions.

types.name: FeedbackResult

fields.name: feedback_id
fields.description: The feedback_id of the FeedbackEntry that was processed.

validators.error_message: feedback_id must be a valid UUID4 string

fields.name: applied_actions
fields.description: Actions that were successfully applied to the calibrator.

fields.name: skipped_actions
fields.description: Actions that were computed but skipped because their dimension is not in ENABLED_DIMENSIONS.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Overall outcome: 'applied' if all actions applied, 'partial' if some skipped, 'skipped' if all skipped.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Optional human-readable explanation when status is not 'applied' (e.g., which dimensions were disabled, or error details).

types.description: Frozen Pydantic model representing the outcome of applying a single FeedbackEntry through the calibration pipeline. Contains both applied and skipped actions for auditability.

types.name: FeedbackResultList
types.description: A list of FeedbackResult structs returned from batch processing.

types.name: FeedbackEntryList
types.description: A list of FeedbackEntry structs, e.g., loaded from feedback.jsonl.

types.name: EnabledSkippedPartition

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Actions whose dimension is in ENABLED_DIMENSIONS.

fields.name: skipped
fields.description: Actions whose dimension is NOT in ENABLED_DIMENSIONS (deferred).

types.description: Return type of filter_enabled_actions: a tuple-like struct containing the enabled actions and skipped actions.

types.name: FeedbackCalibrationConfig

fields.name: helpful_confidence_delta
fields.description: Positive delta applied to agent_confidence when rating is 'helpful'.

validators.error_message: Must be a positive float in (0.0, 1.0]

fields.name: wrong_confidence_delta
fields.description: Negative delta magnitude applied to agent_confidence when rating is 'wrong'.

validators.error_message: Must be a positive float in (0.0, 1.0]

fields.name: irrelevant_confidence_delta
fields.description: Negative delta magnitude (smaller than 'wrong') applied to agent_confidence when rating is 'irrelevant'.

validators.error_message: Must be a positive float in (0.0, 1.0]

fields.name: already_knew_confidence_delta
fields.description: Mild positive delta applied to agent_confidence when rating is 'already_knew' (correct but low novelty).

validators.error_message: Must be a positive float in (0.0, 1.0]

fields.name: already_knew_surfacing_priority_delta
fields.description: Negative delta magnitude applied to surfacing_priority when rating is 'already_knew' (slight decrease — correct but low novelty). Deferred until surfacing_priority is enabled.

validators.error_message: Must be a positive float in (0.0, 1.0]

fields.name: enabled_dimensions
fields.description: List of CalibrationDimension values that are currently active. Actions targeting other dimensions are skipped and logged. Initially only 'agent_confidence'.

types.description: Pydantic config model holding named magnitude constants for each rating→dimension pair and the set of enabled dimensions. Loaded from YAML with sensible defaults. All delta values are positive magnitudes; sign is determined by the mapping logic.

types.name: CalibratorProtocol

fields.name: calibration_lr_up
fields.description: Async method signature: async def calibration_lr_up(agent_id: str, delta: float) -> None. Increases the calibration learning rate / confidence for the specified agent.

fields.name: calibration_lr_down
fields.description: Async method signature: async def calibration_lr_down(agent_id: str, delta: float) -> None. Decreases the calibration learning rate / confidence for the specified agent.

types.description: typing.Protocol defining the interface to the concrete calibration system (attention/calibration.py). Decouples feedback_calibration from the concrete implementation. Must implement calibration_lr_up and calibration_lr_down as async methods. Structural subtyping — no inheritance required.

functions.name: map_rating_to_actions
functions.description: Pure synchronous function. Maps a FeedbackRating to a complete list of CalibrationActions across ALL dimensions (including deferred ones). Uses exhaustive match with assert_never to guarantee all rating variants are handled. The returned actions represent the full intent; filtering by enabled dimensions happens separately. Rating→action mapping: 'helpful' → [agent_confidence +helpful_confidence_delta], 'wrong' → [agent_confidence -wrong_confidence_delta], 'irrelevant' → [agent_confidence -irrelevant_confidence_delta], 'already_knew' → [agent_confidence +already_knew_confidence_delta, surfacing_priority -already_knew_surfacing_priority_delta].

inputs.name: rating
inputs.description: The feedback rating to map to calibration actions.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuration holding the magnitude constants. Uses defaults if not provided.

error_cases.name: invalid_rating
error_cases.condition: rating value is not a valid FeedbackRating variant (should be impossible with proper typing; assert_never catches at runtime)

preconditions: rating is a valid FeedbackRating variant
config contains valid positive magnitude values for all delta fields
postconditions: Returned list is non-empty (every rating produces at least one action)
Each action has a non-empty description
Each action's delta is in [-1.0, 1.0]
For 'helpful': exactly 1 action with dimension='agent_confidence' and delta > 0
For 'wrong': exactly 1 action with dimension='agent_confidence' and delta < 0
For 'irrelevant': exactly 1 action with dimension='agent_confidence' and delta < 0, abs(delta) < abs(wrong delta)
For 'already_knew': exactly 2 actions — agent_confidence with delta > 0, surfacing_priority with delta < 0
All FeedbackRating variants are exhaustively handled (assert_never guarantees this at type-check time)

functions.name: filter_enabled_actions
functions.description: Pure synchronous function. Partitions a list of CalibrationActions into (enabled, skipped) based on the ENABLED_DIMENSIONS gate from config. Actions whose dimension is in enabled_dimensions are placed in the enabled list; all others go to skipped. Skipped actions represent deferred feature dimensions.

inputs.name: actions
inputs.description: The full list of calibration actions to partition.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuration containing the enabled_dimensions set. Defaults to only 'agent_confidence'.

preconditions: actions is a valid list of CalibrationAction (may be empty)
postconditions: len(enabled) + len(skipped) == len(actions) — all input actions are accounted for
Every action in enabled has dimension in config.enabled_dimensions
Every action in skipped has dimension NOT in config.enabled_dimensions
Order of actions is preserved within each partition

functions.name: apply_feedback
functions.description: Async I/O function. Processes a single FeedbackEntry: maps rating to actions, filters by enabled dimensions, applies enabled actions via the CalibratorProtocol, and returns a FeedbackResult. For positive deltas calls calibrator.calibration_lr_up; for negative deltas calls calibrator.calibration_lr_down with abs(delta). Skipped actions (deferred dimensions) are logged at DEBUG level and included in FeedbackResult.skipped_actions.

inputs.name: calibrator
inputs.description: The calibrator instance implementing calibration_lr_up and calibration_lr_down.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuration for magnitude constants and enabled dimensions.

error_cases.name: calibrator_error
error_cases.condition: calibrator.calibration_lr_up or calibrator.calibration_lr_down raises an exception

error_data.original_error: String representation of the underlying exception

error_cases.name: invalid_entry
error_cases.condition: entry fails Pydantic validation (e.g., empty agent_id, invalid feedback_id format)

preconditions: entry is a valid FeedbackEntry with non-empty agent_id and finding_id
calibrator implements CalibratorProtocol (has async calibration_lr_up and calibration_lr_down methods)
entry.feedback_id is a valid UUID4 string
postconditions: result.feedback_id == entry.feedback_id
result.status is 'applied' if all actions were enabled and applied successfully
result.status is 'partial' if some actions were skipped due to disabled dimensions
result.status is 'skipped' if all actions were skipped (no enabled dimensions matched)
len(result.applied_actions) + len(result.skipped_actions) == total actions from map_rating_to_actions
calibrator.calibration_lr_up was called once for each applied action with delta > 0
calibrator.calibration_lr_down was called once for each applied action with delta < 0
side_effects: Calls calibrator.calibration_lr_up or calibration_lr_down to mutate agent confidence scores
Logs skipped actions at DEBUG level
Logs applied actions at INFO level

functions.name: process_feedback_batch
functions.description: Async I/O function. Processes a sequence of FeedbackEntry items sequentially (to preserve ordering semantics of feedback), applying each via apply_feedback. Collects and returns all FeedbackResults. If an individual entry fails, its error is captured in the result (status='skipped', reason=error message) and processing continues with the next entry — batch processing is fail-safe.

inputs.name: entries
inputs.description: Sequence of feedback entries to process in order.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuration for magnitude constants and enabled dimensions.

error_cases.name: entry_processing_error
error_cases.condition: An individual entry fails during apply_feedback (calibrator error, validation error, etc.)

error_data.detail: Error is captured in the corresponding FeedbackResult with status='skipped' and reason containing the error message. No exception is raised to the caller for individual failures.

preconditions: entries is a valid sequence of FeedbackEntry (may be empty)
postconditions: len(results) == len(entries) — one result per input entry
results[i].feedback_id == entries[i].feedback_id for all i
Entries are processed sequentially in input order
A failure on entry[i] does not prevent processing of entry[i+1]
If entries is empty, returns an empty list
side_effects: Calls calibrator methods for each entry's enabled actions
Logs each entry's processing outcome at INFO level
Logs individual failures at WARNING level

functions.name: load_feedback
functions.description: Async I/O function. Reads and parses all feedback entries from .stigmergy/feedback.jsonl. Each line is a JSON object parsed into a FeedbackEntry. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are skipped. Returns entries in file order (chronological).

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Filesystem path to the feedback JSONL file (typically '.stigmergy/feedback.jsonl').

error_cases.name: file_not_found
error_cases.condition: The feedback.jsonl file does not exist at the specified path

error_data.detail: Returns empty list — not an error. File is created on first append.

error_cases.name: permission_error
error_cases.condition: Insufficient filesystem permissions to read the file

error_data.path: The path that could not be read

error_cases.name: corrupt_line
error_cases.condition: A line in the JSONL file is not valid JSON or does not conform to FeedbackEntry schema

error_data.line_number: 1-based line number of the corrupt line
error_data.raw_line: The raw text of the corrupt line

preconditions: path is a valid filesystem path string
postconditions: All returned entries are valid FeedbackEntry instances
Entries are in the same order as they appear in the file
If the file is empty, returns an empty list
If the file does not exist, returns an empty list (not an error — fresh install)

functions.name: append_feedback
functions.description: Async I/O function. Atomically appends a single FeedbackEntry as a JSON line to .stigmergy/feedback.jsonl. Uses atomic write strategy: write to a temp file in the same directory, then append content, ensuring no partial writes on crash. Creates parent directories and the file if they do not exist. Each entry is serialized as a single JSON line terminated by newline.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Filesystem path to the feedback JSONL file (typically '.stigmergy/feedback.jsonl').

error_cases.name: permission_error
error_cases.condition: Insufficient filesystem permissions to write to the file or create directories

error_data.path: The path that could not be written

error_cases.name: disk_full
error_cases.condition: No space left on device during write

error_data.path: The path that could not be written

error_cases.name: serialization_error
error_cases.condition: FeedbackEntry cannot be serialized to JSON (should not happen with Pydantic model, but defensive)

preconditions: path is a valid filesystem path string
postconditions: The file at path exists after the call
The file contains the entry as the last line (JSON-serialized, newline-terminated)
All previously existing lines in the file are preserved and unmodified
Parent directories are created if they did not exist
The write is atomic — either the full line is appended or nothing is written
side_effects: May create the file if it does not exist

invariants: ENABLED_DIMENSIONS is a frozenset; initially frozenset({'agent_confidence'}). Only dimensions in this set are applied; all others are skipped and logged.
All FeedbackEntry instances are frozen (immutable) after construction.
All CalibrationAction instances are frozen (immutable) after construction.
All FeedbackResult instances are frozen (immutable) after construction.
map_rating_to_actions uses exhaustive match with assert_never — adding a new FeedbackRating variant without updating the match is a type error.
Feedback processing order is preserved: batch entries are processed sequentially in input order to maintain temporal consistency of calibration adjustments.
The feedback.jsonl file is append-only; existing entries are never modified or deleted.
All delta magnitudes in FeedbackCalibrationConfig are positive; the sign (up/down) is determined by map_rating_to_actions based on rating semantics.
CalibratorProtocol uses structural subtyping (typing.Protocol) — no inheritance from a base class is required.
Deferred dimensions (surfacing_priority, business_weight, familiarity_weight) are computed in map_rating_to_actions but filtered out by filter_enabled_actions until Features 3 and 4 enable them.
A 'helpful' rating always results in calibration_lr_up on agent_confidence.
A 'wrong' rating always results in calibration_lr_down on agent_confidence with the largest negative magnitude.
An 'irrelevant' rating always results in calibration_lr_down on agent_confidence with a smaller magnitude than 'wrong'.
An 'already_knew' rating results in a mild calibration_lr_up on agent_confidence AND a deferred calibration_lr_down on surfacing_priority.
wrong_confidence_delta > irrelevant_confidence_delta (wrong is penalized more heavily than irrelevant).
